ARCHIPELAGO_POWER_VAKUU_TRAP_POWER.title: Vakuu Trap
ARCHIPELAGO_POWER_VAKUU_TRAP_POWER.descr: Vakuu will play your hand next turn (no earlier than turn 2). Each stack grants one autoplay turn. Expires when combat ends.
ARCHIPELAGO_POWER_FOREWARNED_POWER.title: Forewarned
ARCHIPELAGO_POWER_FOREWARNED_POWER.descr: When enemies attack you on their turn and your Block stops all of it, draw 1 more card next turn.
